def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

def upscale(grid, factor):
    """Each cell as a factor x factor block of its color."""
    return [[v for v in row for _ in range(factor)] for row in grid for _ in range(factor)]

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):
    """The height x width subgrid whose top-left cell is (top, left)."""
    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]

def trim(grid):
    """The grid without its outermost rows and columns."""
    return [row[1:-1] for row in grid[1:-1]]

def replace(grid, old, new):
    """The grid with every cell of color old recolored new."""
    return [[new if v == old else v for v in row] for row in grid]

def hperiod(grid):
    """The smallest p such that every row repeats itself every p cells: the grid's width if none is smaller."""
    w = len(grid[0])
    return next(p for p in range(1, w + 1) if all(row[j] == row[j - p] for row in grid for j in range(p, w)))

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    line=next(i for i,row in enumerate(grid) if set(row)=={5})
    tops=[(col,cells) for col,cells in components([row[:] for row in grid[:line]]) if cells]
    bcol,bcells=[(col,cells) for col,cells in components([row[:] for row in grid[line+1:]]) if cells][-1]
    bcells=[(r+line+1,c) for r,c in bcells]
    twin=next((k for k,(col,cells) in enumerate(tops) if norm(cells)==norm(bcells)),None)
    tops=[t for k,t in enumerate(tops) if k!=twin]
    tops.sort(key=lambda t:-bbox(t[1])[1])
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    placed=set()
    for col,cells in tops:
        r0,c0,r1,c1=bbox(cells)
        dr=(line-1)-r1; dc=min(c for _,c in bcells)-c0
        nc=[(r+dr,c+dc) for r,c in cells]
        if any(p in placed for p in nc): continue
        for r,c in nc: out[r][c]=col; placed.add((r,c))
    r0=min(r for r,_ in bcells)
    for r,c in bcells: out[r-(r0-line)][c]=bcol
    return out[:line+4]

helper = '''

def conn_components(grid, bg=0):
    """4-connected components of non-background cells as (color, [(r,c),...]) lists."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set(); out = []
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if grid[i][j] != bg and (i, j) not in seen:
                col = grid[i][j]; stack = [(i, j)]; cells = []; seen.add((i, j))
                while stack:
                    a, b = stack.pop(); cells.append((a, b))
                    for da, db in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                        x, y = a + da, b + db
                        if 0 <= x < h and 0 <= y < w and grid[x][y] == col and (x, y) not in seen:
                            seen.add((x, y)); stack.append((x, y))
                out.append((col, cells))
    return out

def cell_bbox(cells):
    """Bounding box (r0, c0, r1, c1) of a list of (r, c) cells."""
    rs = [c[0] for c in cells]; cs = [c[1] for c in cells]
    return min(rs), min(cs), max(rs), max(cs)

def shape_key(cells):
    """Translation-invariant frozenset of a shape's cells."""
    r0, c0, _, _ = cell_bbox(cells)
    return frozenset((r - r0, c - c0) for r, c in cells)

def stack_shapes_at_line(grid, sep=5):
    """Shapes across a separator line: the bottom shape and non-twin top shapes touch the line, left-aligned; rightmost top shape wins overlaps; output cropped to the line + 3 rows."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    line = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if set(row) == {sep})
    tops = [(c, cells) for c, cells in conn_components([row[:] for row in grid[:line]])]
    bcol, bcells = [(c, cells) for c, cells in conn_components([row[:] for row in grid[line + 1:]])][-1]
    bcells = [(r + line + 1, c) for r, c in bcells]
    twin = next((k for k, (c, cells) in enumerate(tops) if shape_key(cells) == shape_key(bcells)), None)
    tops = [t for k, t in enumerate(tops) if k != twin]
    tops.sort(key=lambda t: -cell_bbox(t[1])[1])
    out = [[0] * w for _ in range(h)]
    placed = set()
    for col, cells in tops:
        r0, c0, r1, _ = cell_bbox(cells)
        dr = (line - 1) - r1; dc = min(c for _, c in bcells) - c0
        nc = [(r + dr, c + dc) for r, c in cells]
        if any(p in placed for p in nc):
            continue
        for r, c in nc:
            out[r][c] = col; placed.add((r, c))
    r0 = min(r for r, _ in bcells)
    for r, c in bcells:
        out[r - (r0 - line)][c] = bcol
    return out[:line + 4]
'''
